scenes.text: This tutorial covers Format Converter. Convert ND2, CZI, LIF, OME-TIFF, and related microscopy formats into mapped Yokogawa-style TIFF files.
Open Format Converter from the Data and batch runs section. Choose source files, series or scenes, channel names, time and depth handling, and an output folder.
In the main configuration area, preview how source dimensions map to plate, well, field, time, depth, and channel indices.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. validate the mapping on a small sample before converting every file.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR writes standardized TIFFs and a map back to the original files and metadata.
